**Escalated (EXC-001):** JE-00298, "Umsatzkorrektur Q1," €9,999 Dr AR / Cr Subscription Revenue, posted late on 2026-03-29 by m.krause with **no support**. Nothing in the document store substantiates it, March DE revenue is fully explained by RE-7107/7108/7109, and at the March policy rate it's USD 10,998.90 — above the USD 10,000 manual-entry limit with no approval requested. Per policy I did not reverse it unilaterally; it's logged for controller review and I marked DE Revenue recognition as blocked.

**Other notes:** all remaining March DE entries tie to correctly-dated support; AP's €19,700 residual balance predates March (closed periods) and was left alone; DE prepaid software is nil and both payrolls were paid within March, so no accrual was warranted.
